title: More models, more modalities, fewer endpoint migrations
summary:
A busy model day: new text and speech options, sharper Grok images, steadier video jobs, and a Discord bot with fewer ways to get stuck.

Gemini Flash-Lite now runs on stable Gemini 3.5 without changing its existing aliases or multimodal, tool, search, structured-output, reasoning, and streaming features. LongCat 2.0 joins the text API with a 1M-token context window and tool support, while CSM 1B adds six-voice text-to-speech through the audio API. The model catalog also learned the proper logos for several of its newer residents.

Basic Grok Imagine image generation and editing now default to 2K output. Grok Imagine Pro and Grok Video Pro moved onto OpenRouter's xAI routes while keeping their existing capabilities, and video jobs now stop after a deliberate three-minute maximum rather than wandering through legacy retries for much longer.

The Discord bot was reorganized, its prompt was trimmed, mention search and X links were repaired, Mermaid fences now render inline, and repeated failed tool calls no longer become a small infinite tragedy.

highlights.title: Polli learned diagrams and better search
highlights.text: The Discord bot now renders Mermaid diagrams inline, handles mention searches and X links more reliably, and stops retrying the same broken tool call forever. [Join the chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
highlights.text: Existing Flash-Lite and `gemini-search-fast` aliases now run on stable Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, keeping multimodal input, tools, web search, structured output, reasoning, and streaming. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: LongCat 2.0
highlights.text: Paid API users can call `longcat`, `longcat-2`, or `longcat-2.0` for reasoning, function tools, streaming, prompt caching, and a rather excessive 1M-token context window. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: CSM 1B speech
highlights.text: Text-to-speech gained CSM 1B: six voices, five output formats, and direct routing for speech that does not need to sound like it came from a voicemail tree. [Try the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/audio/{text})

highlights.title: Grok Imagine defaults to 2K
highlights.text: Basic `grok-imagine-image` generation and editing now produce sharper 2K images by default. More pixels, same request. [Generate an image](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt})
